properties.name: Külső Árpádváros
properties.sourceScopeNote: One of the three separately named constituent units expressly identified on PDF161 and described on PDF161–162; the broader Mezeiváros és környezete group is not duplicated under each fine name.
properties.method: Literal original Figure76 maxRGB<=45 black-source-pixel circuits, every dense edge an 8-neighbor source step. Shared dividers are reused exactly; no source-frame closure, label crossing, invented connector, simplification, buffer, snap or repair. Actual photographic texture establishes a Figure73-to-Figure76 image affine relation: ten fitted and ten separately held-out NCC patches, with no world coordinates, names or boundary rings used by image matching. The inverse image relation is composed with the archived Figure73 EOV affine calibration, independently recomputed from its six approximate real-road-node correspondences. The Figure73 geographic placement remains unvalidated, and Figure76 contours partly extend beyond the observed common-image overlap. All output is therefore an explicit inferred geographic candidate; exact source contours are proved separately from placement.
properties.sourcePeriod: 2021 May municipal consultation draft; original orthophoto capture date unknown.
properties.license: Municipal source-map reuse rights unverified; ODbL-1.0 for OSM geographical controls and name points.

sourceRaster.coordinateConvention: Integer exact original-image pixel centers, x right/y down, no extra half-pixel offset.

properties.attribution: Kecskemét MJV Megalapozó Vizsgálat II., May2021 consultation draft, Figure76; geographical controls ©OpenStreetMap contributors.
reviewNotes: All source contour vertices and shared dividers are original black JPEG pixels; no missing source boundary is reconstructed.
Photographic texture supports a common Figure73/Figure76 image relation only within observed overlap. Southern, western and eastern contour portions extend beyond this observed overlap.
Figure73 geographic calibration is inherited as an unvalidated estimate, including its failed excluded physical-control candidate; image matching cannot make it a verified geographic registration.
Current exact name scope, current/legal boundaries, source-map reuse rights and address assignment remain unverified.
